status: frozen by the Gate-2 vote (v16 §19, 2026-08-19); not production-closed
encoding: RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding; untagged COSE structures
external_aad: zero-length for every Sig_structure in this profile

vectors.title: Profile-valid issuer-signed CWT credential (cnf/tenant/clearance) presented in the proof slot
vectors.deny_rule: a valid credential (typ application/cwt, issuer-signed, with cnf, tenant, and clearance) is not a request proof: its typ is not application/vnd.hyprstream.proof+cwt and it is not signed by a cnf-bound proof key
vectors.notes: A profile-valid v16 (Reusable) credential: registered claims, RFC 8747 cnf PoP binding, tenant -70005, clearance -70006, and no use-profile field. Only its presentation slot is wrong.

vectors.title: Proof CWT (COSE_Sign) presented in the credential/authorization slot
vectors.deny_rule: credential verification requires the credential typ (application/cwt or at+jwt) and an issuer key; the proof carries the proof typ and is signed by a cnf-bound request-proof key
vectors.notes: Same bytes as P-2 (a COSE_Sign), presented in the wrong slot.

vectors.title: Protected typ (label 16) absent
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 9596 typ is REQUIRED in the body protected headers

vectors.title: Correct typ with response-proof hs_domain
vectors.deny_rule: typ and hs_domain must both match the request-proof profile

vectors.title: Hybrid proof with the ML-DSA-65 signature entry stripped
vectors.deny_rule: the retained Ed25519 entry's Sig_structure still covers the hybrid signature_plan, so it cannot verify under the standalone classical suite; the missing plan component denies independently
vectors.notes: The surviving Ed25519 signature is cryptographically valid over the mutated object.

vectors.title: signature_plan with nine signer groups
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: 1*8 signer groups

vectors.title: signer group with three components
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: 1*2 components per signer group

vectors.title: Unknown private-use claim key -70050 in the claims set
vectors.deny_rule: an unknown claim key denies; CWT has no critical-claims mechanism

vectors.title: Claims map keys not in deterministic order
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 8949 core deterministic encoding: map keys sorted bytewise

vectors.title: Indefinite-length claims map
vectors.deny_rule: definite lengths only

vectors.title: Floating-point exp timestamp
vectors.deny_rule: integer Unix seconds only; no floating-point values anywhere

vectors.title: Duplicate aud claim key
vectors.deny_rule: no duplicate claim keys

vectors.title: crit omits hs_domain
vectors.deny_rule: crit sets are exact, not minimums

vectors.title: crit carries an unknown extension label
vectors.deny_rule: an unrecognized critical label denies; the label is also absent from the bucket

vectors.title: crit names hs_domain but the parameter is absent from the same protected bucket
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 9052: every crit label must occur in the same protected bucket

vectors.title: Duplicate crit entry
vectors.deny_rule: crit entries are unique and in ascending numeric-label order

vectors.title: crit entries in descending label order
vectors.deny_rule: entries use ascending numeric-label order

vectors.title: Credential-bound proof carrying hs_unattributed_key_set
vectors.deny_rule: the unattributed key set is absent whenever a credential is presented

vectors.title: Signature entry using deprecated polymorphic EdDSA (-8)
vectors.deny_rule: RFC 9864 fully-specified algorithms: Ed25519 components use -19

vectors.title: Unknown suite_id (65 bytes) outside the closed suite set
vectors.deny_rule: the suite registry is closed; an unknown suite_id denies (also > 64 bytes)

vectors.title: kid of 65 bytes
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: kid 1..64 bytes

vectors.title: Required claim credential_hash absent rather than null
vectors.deny_rule: every listed claim is always present; inapplicable values encode as null

vectors.title: Credential presented with a null signed credential_hash
vectors.deny_rule: hash absence is permitted only when no credential is presented
vectors.notes: Presentation context: an at+jwt credential accompanies this proof.

vectors.title: Unattributed proof with no Nonce (server challenge)
vectors.deny_rule: the challenge is REQUIRED for unattributed proofs, before any replay-store insertion

vectors.title: alg and kid carried only in the unprotected header
vectors.deny_rule: algorithm and key identifiers in unprotected headers establish no authority

vectors.title: Unattributed key set carrying a key with no plan component
vectors.deny_rule: every key-set element must match exactly one plan component; a surplus element denies the complete proof rather than being ignored

vectors.title: Response proof carrying hs_unattributed_key_set
vectors.deny_rule: a self-asserted response key is never authoritative

vectors.title: Signature entry declaring a logical signer group absent from the plan
vectors.deny_rule: every signature entry matches exactly one plan component by group, alg, and kid

vectors.title: Tagged COSE_Sign1 (CBOR tag 18)
vectors.deny_rule: this closed profile carries no tags; the typ header performs object typing

vectors.title: Response proof whose cti does not echo the originating request's request_id
vectors.deny_rule: a response proof's cti MUST equal the originating request's request_id
vectors.notes: Signature valid over the mutated cti; denies on the contextual request-ID mismatch.

vectors.title: Encrypted response_binding (protection_mode 2) with a null KEM recipient
vectors.deny_rule: recipient is non-null iff protection_mode is encrypted
vectors.notes: Gate-2 §19 #4: the encrypted shape requires a present kem-recipient.

vectors.title: Cleartext response_binding (protection_mode 1) carrying a KEM recipient
vectors.deny_rule: recipient is null iff protection_mode is cleartext
vectors.notes: Gate-2 §19 #4: the cleartext shape forbids a kem-recipient.

vectors.title: response_kind value 3 outside the closed enum {1 unary, 2 stream_setup}
vectors.deny_rule: response_kind is a closed enum: 1 unary or 2 stream_setup

vectors.title: aud of 129 bytes, over the 128-byte MAX_SERVICE_DOMAIN_BYTES cap
vectors.deny_rule: aud is 1..128 bytes (Gate-2 §19 #7; shared MAX_SERVICE_DOMAIN_BYTES)

vectors.title: Cleartext unary response_binding carried as a non-null map
vectors.deny_rule: cleartext unary uses a null response_binding; the map form is stream_setup only
vectors.notes: Canonical single encoding: cleartext unary is null, never a map.

vectors.title: Hybrid suite plan with only one Ed25519 component (hybrid→classical downgrade)
vectors.deny_rule: hs-cose-sign-ed25519-mldsa65-wns-v1 requires exactly two ordered components (Ed25519 then ML-DSA-65); a single-component hybrid group denies
vectors.notes: Causal hybrid-to-classical downgrade: the suite is bound to its exact plan.

vectors.title: aud with an uppercase byte (Registry.svc), rejected by the service-domain syntax
vectors.deny_rule: canonical service domain is lowercase ASCII only (validate_service_domain)

vectors.title: aud with an illegal first byte ('-registry.svc')
vectors.deny_rule: the first byte must be a lowercase ASCII letter or digit (validate_service_domain)

vectors.title: Response proof whose response_binding mismatches the originating request (P-4)
vectors.deny_rule: a response proof's response_binding MUST equal the originating request's map field-for-field; a differing root_type_id denies
vectors.notes: Locally valid map shape; denies only against the request it answers.

vectors.title: Bound response proof whose -70002 mismatches the realized response_binding root_type_id
vectors.deny_rule: for a non-null response_binding, claim -70002 MUST equal the binding's root_type_id (key 1)
vectors.notes: Only -70002 differs; the binding map still equals P-4's and the signature is valid.

vectors.title: COSE_Sign plan repeating one (alg, kid) across two logical groups
vectors.deny_rule: every (alg, kid) pair MUST be unique across the whole plan, regardless of group ID
vectors.notes: Both signatures are valid; a single signer must not satisfy a two-group policy.

vectors.title: Unattributed proof whose embedded key set does not match the signing key
vectors.deny_rule: each unattributed signature MUST verify against its embedded key set key
vectors.notes: Correct kid/alg/crv but a different public key; re-signed with the real key over the mutated bucket, so it denies at embedded-key verification, not by a plan-shape or self-signature failure.

vectors.title: Hybrid unattributed key set duplicating the Ed25519 element (no ML-DSA-65 key)
vectors.deny_rule: key set element i MUST correspond to plan component i by kid/alg/kty
vectors.notes: Element 1 is Ed25519 where the plan's component 1 is ML-DSA-65.

vectors.title: Hybrid unattributed key set with elements reordered out of plan component order
vectors.deny_rule: key set elements MUST be in the plan's exact component order
vectors.notes: Element 0 is ML-DSA-65 where component 0 is Ed25519.

vectors.title: signature_plan with two groups sharing one group_id
vectors.deny_rule: group IDs MUST be unique and strictly ascending across the plan
vectors.notes: Both signatures valid; distinct (alg,kid); denies solely on the duplicate group_id.

vectors.title: signature_plan with group IDs out of ascending order
vectors.deny_rule: group IDs MUST be strictly ascending across the plan
vectors.notes: Both signatures valid; groups are 2 then 1.

vectors.title: Unattributed key set with three elements, over the 1..2 ceiling
vectors.deny_rule: the unattributed key set carries 1..2 elements (frozen cap)
vectors.notes: All signatures valid; denies solely on the over-ceiling key-set size.

vectors.title: Response proof whose aud differs from the originating request's service domain
vectors.deny_rule: a response proof's aud MUST equal the originating request's aud
vectors.notes: Only aud differs; cti and response_binding still equal P-4's; signature valid.

vectors.title: capnp_body_bytes of 1 MiB + 1, one byte over the 1048576 cap
vectors.deny_rule: capnp-body-bytes is 0..1048576 (1 MiB body cap)
vectors.notes: Object stays under the 2 MiB cap; denies solely on the body-length rule.

vectors.title: Unattributed proof whose Nonce is 15 bytes, under the 16-byte floor
vectors.deny_rule: server-challenge is 16..64 bytes
vectors.notes: Valid unattributed structure/signature; denies solely on the Nonce lower bound.

vectors.title: Unattributed proof whose Nonce is 65 bytes, over the 64-byte ceiling
vectors.deny_rule: server-challenge is 16..64 bytes
vectors.notes: Valid unattributed structure/signature; denies solely on the Nonce upper bound.

vectors.title: kid of 0 bytes, under the 1-byte floor
vectors.deny_rule: proof-v1 cap: kid 1..64 bytes
vectors.notes: Empty kid violates the kid lower bound independently of the aud .regexp.

vectors.title: Truncated CBOR: response signature bstr header declares 65 bytes with 64 present
vectors.deny_rule: a length-delimited value must have at least the declared number of bytes
vectors.notes: Header widened 58 40 -> 58 41, no byte added; strict decoder rejects (len(rest) < val).
